title: The sign-in gate's chat bubble stays hidden for a seat when the state answer fails, errors or does not say chatEnabled
steps: S1: Run vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords test/tracy/chat-entry-client.test.ts (mounts the real ChatLauncher with a faked fetch).
expect: S1: 500 answer, thrown fetch, and an OK answer without chatEnabled render no bubble and fetch no messages; chatEnabled true shows it.
evidence: Found 09/10/2026 while closing the avatar debt of PR #1082: chat.tsx set the bubble 'on' in its catch and on !res.ok.
fence: Client hook H18 (src/client/tracy/chat-entry.ts). Not covered: the server's chat policy.

tests: K6: the bubble stays hidden when the state answer is an error
K6: the bubble stays hidden when the state request itself fails
K6: the bubble stays hidden when the state answer does not say "on"
K6: the bubble shows when the state answer says this account switched it on
